title: Sands of Service
description: Three of the temple's ceremonial hourglasses cracked in the same month - old glass, nobody's fault - and the equinox rite cannot be measured by guesswork. The Priest of Chronos needs fresh sacred sand from three blessed sites to cast new ones: Elder Moor's old timekeeping shrine, a windswept hilltop near Thornfield, and the ruins of Willow Dale where time once stood still. A rite run without a working glass is not a rite Chronos recognizes.

objectives.description: Collect sacred sand from Elder Moor
Collect sacred sand from the hilltop near Thornfield
Collect sacred sand from Willow Dale Ruins
Deliver the three sands before the equinox rite

notes: Threat: three broken hourglasses mean the equinox rite has no honest way to measure itself. Giver motive: the priest needs the glasses cast in time, not out of vanity but because an unmeasured rite is null to Chronos by his own doctrine. Consequence: if the sand is not gathered, the rite is held anyway on guesswork, which the priest regards privately as no rite at all - not wired mechanically.
